They feature visible metal ring mechanisms on the spine side and appear to be made of flexible polypropylene or similar plastic.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text/logo on the yellow binder appears slightly smudged or indistinct, lacking the crisp edges of real printed ink, suggesting minor AI generation softness.
The metal rings on the magenta binder seem to merge slightly into the plastic spine without clear mechanical separation or shadowing, appearing somewhat 'melted' or physically implausible.
The geometry of the blue binder's spine curves unnaturally where it meets the back cover, deviating slightly from expected rigid plastic behavior.
